name: Hana Al Zahed
bio: Hana El Zahed is an Egyptian actress. She was born in 1994. She debuted as an actress in the 2014 film "Khettet Jimmy" (Jimmy's Plan). She then went on to appear in Tamer Hosny's television series "Farq Tawqit" (Bad Timing).
